report.title: Learning a shared control policy
report.subtitle: Inspect the training record, verify the score definition and separate one-run uncertainty from repeatability.
findings: The first complete 100-episode window meeting the score criterion ends at episode 607.
100 completed evaluation episodes have mean score 2.067.
The sequence-level block-bootstrap interval is 1.758 to 2.349; this is not a multi-seed benchmark.

methodology.title: Independent score audit
methodology.body: Validate consecutive episode IDs, finite agent returns, max-agent episode scores and truncation flags. No rolling window shorter than 100 episodes qualifies; any truncation invalidates its window.

methodology.title: Saved policy evaluation
methodology.body: Evaluation records come from the saved policy with exploration and learning disabled. A circular block bootstrap uses blocks of ten episodes to retain local sequential structure.

methodology.title: Decision boundary
methodology.body: These are historical simulation records from one training seed. No fresh Unity training or additional environment runs are claimed. The critic uses local observations and actions, not a centralized joint state.

report.notes: The audit runs without the legacy Unity environment. Source score files and checkpoint weights remain inspectable in the repository.

uncertainty.scope: Circular block bootstrap of one evaluation sequence; not variation across independent training seeds.
